regulation_ref: Customs duty structure of the destination as encoded for this prototype; the rates are placeholders for a reviewer to confirm against the current customs tariff, not an official source

IN.note: Basic customs duty (BCD) on the assessable value; social welfare surcharge (SWS) on the BCD; integrated GST (IGST) on assessable value + BCD + SWS + any anti-dumping duty

SG.note: No customs duty on this tariff area (customs duty applies to a few goods only); GST on the CIF value plus any duty
